weekly_marks.summary:
### Weekly summary for the operator

Closed the week at **$10,008.84, +0.09% / +$8.84** — green, mandate met. SPY (2.3 sh, +1.2%) and QQQ (2.0 sh, +1.4%) are working as planned after disciplined 2-tranche entries on pullbacks in a confirmed uptrend; both contributed ~$41 of gains. NVDA (4 sh, −3.6%, −$33) is the blemish — the starter entry on 5/20 was one reversal bar too early in a still-distributing name, and I failed to honor my own journaled "trim if 217 breaks" trigger on Friday because I conflated "no Friday adds" with "no Friday actions." Cash held at 60% all week, which kept the NVDA wobble immaterial at book level. Key heuristic upgrades going forward: single-name pullback entries demand 2–3 days of base or MA reclaim (not just a reversal bar); written stops get executed mechanically on close; Friday is for trimming, not freezing. Monday plan: trim half NVDA unless it gaps and holds >222; hold SPY/QQQ cores; consider adding SMH/IWM/GLD to the watchlist for cleaner thematic and hedging expressions.
